summary: The verifier is requirement-complete and behavior-oriented. It combines direct execution of documented COBOL decision interfaces with independent end-to-end database/artifact scenarios and has strong Oracle/NOP discrimination.

evidence.observation: Tests recreate independent SQLite states, call documented COBOL interfaces, execute the batch and assert durable outcomes rather than source patterns.
Regression cases cover current-cycle history, inconsistent restart state and stable accepted/rejected/publication behavior.
Every declared requirement has at least one mapped test; suite contains 30 F2P and 7 P2P cases.
Oracle 37/37 PASS; NOP exactly 30 F2P failures and 7 P2P passes; reward behavior is binary.
Verifier initializes reward to 0 and writes exactly 1 on full pytest success or 0 otherwise.

change_scope: Fresh semantic review under protocol 2.1 / packet-result schema v3; solver-visible task content unchanged.
do_not_change: Do not weaken behavioral verifier coverage or exactly-once/restart invariants merely to improve agent pass rate.

role_output.IMPLEMENTATION_COUPLING: LOW — direct COBOL checks exercise solver-visible stable interfaces; end-to-end tests grade state/artifact behavior.
role_output.FLAKINESS_RISK: LOW — scenarios recreate deterministic SQLite state and use bounded local subprocesses.
role_output.ANTI_CHEAT_RISK: LOW — reward depends on semantic behavior across independent states; no source-text shortcuts observed.
role_output.ORACLE_NOP_ASSESSMENT: STRONG — Oracle passes every case; untouched starter fails every F2P while preserving all P2P.
